about: Every source GovGraph uses: organizations (who publishes), their history (lineage), and programs and collections (what they publish, under what terms, how we get it; GLOSSARY.md). Entered by hand; loaded by server/seed/load-sources.js; checked by server/lib/sources.test.js. Files are not listed here: they are found in the data folder and matched to a dataset by `paths` (prefixes of their path in the data folder). Federal works are public domain under 17 U.S.C. 105; any other licence was read on the publisher's site on the date in `checked`.

programs.name: Statistical Abstract of the United States
programs.description: The yearly compendium of U.S. statistics, published from 1878; every table names its source. GovGraph's list of what to collect and the order its data is arranged in. The 2012 edition (131st) is the last.

licence.note: Tables from private sources may be copyrighted by those sources; the Abstract says so.

programs.name: ProQuest Statistical Abstract of the United States
programs.description: ProQuest's continuation of the Statistical Abstract after the Census Bureau ended it, from the 2013 edition.

licence.note: Sold by subscription.

programs.outside_abstract: A private continuation of the Abstract, listed for completeness; not collected.

programs.name: Current Population Survey: Labor Force Statistics
programs.description: The monthly household survey behind the unemployment rate: employment, unemployment and the labor force, by sex, race, age, education and more, from 1940. BLS survey code `ln`.

access.note: download.bls.gov refuses requests without a contact address in the User-Agent (BLS_CONTACT_EMAIL). Every series is read from the survey file ln.data.1.AllData; the three headline series came from the API until 2026-10-13 (same values; those files are kept under api.bls.gov/).

programs.name: Consumer Price Index
programs.description: Prices paid by urban consumers, all items from 1913. BLS survey code `cu`.

access.note: download.bls.gov refuses requests without a contact address in the User-Agent (BLS_CONTACT_EMAIL).

programs.name: National Income and Product Accounts
programs.description: GDP and its parts, personal income and spending, PCE prices, government receipts and expenditures, trade: every NIPA series in flat files by frequency.

programs.name: Petroleum and Other Liquids
programs.description: Crude oil spot prices, retail gasoline and diesel prices, and product supplied (U.S. oil demand).

access.note: The petroleum bulk file, www.eia.gov/opendata/bulk/PET.zip (no key; updated weekly, a few days behind the API). The API v2 with EIA_API_KEY was used until 2026-10-13 (same values; those files are kept under api.eia.gov/).

programs.name: Debt to the Penny
programs.description: Total public debt outstanding and debt held by the public, each business day from April 1993.

programs.name: Monthly Treasury Statement
programs.description: Each month's federal receipts, outlays and deficit, receipts by source and refunds, from FY 2015 in Fiscal Data.

programs.name: Daily Treasury Statement
programs.description: Treasury's cash each business day: tax deposits and refund withdrawals, from October 2005.

programs.name: Historical Tables, Budget of the U.S. Government
programs.description: Receipts, outlays, deficits and debt by fiscal year from 1934 (some from 1789), published with each President's Budget.

programs.name: The Distribution of Household Income
programs.description: Average federal tax rates and shares of federal taxes by income group, 1979–2022 (supplemental data).

access.note: cbo.gov refuses scripted requests, so the file is taken from the Internet Archive's capture of it.

programs.name: SOI Historical Tables
programs.description: Statistics of Income historical tables: Table 23, individual income tax brackets 1913–2018; Table 24, corporate brackets.

programs.name: U.S. Imports for Consumption, Duties Collected, and Ratio of Duties to Value
programs.description: Customs duties and the value of imports each year from 1891, a PDF table.

access.note: usitc.gov refuses scripted requests, so the file is taken from the Internet Archive's capture of it.

programs.name: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services (FT-900)
programs.description: Exports, imports and the trade balance on a balance of payments basis: yearly from 1960, monthly from 1992 (historical series).

programs.name: Historical Income Tables
programs.description: Household income from the Current Population Survey's Annual Social and Economic Supplement (Table H-5 and others), and state income from the decennial censuses.

programs.name: Housing Vacancies and Homeownership (CPS/HVS)
programs.description: Homeownership and vacancy rates, quarterly from 1964 (historical tables).

programs.name: New Residential Sales
programs.description: New single-family homes sold and for sale, their prices and months' supply, monthly from 1963. Published jointly with the Department of Housing and Urban Development.

access.note: The history spreadsheet census.gov/construction/nrs/xls/price_cust.xlsx (no key). The Census API with CENSUS_API_KEY was used until 2026-10-13 (same values; that file is kept under api.census.gov/).

programs.name: Primary Mortgage Market Survey
programs.description: Average 30-year and 15-year fixed mortgage rates, weekly from April 1971.

licence.attribution: Freddie Mac, Primary Mortgage Market Survey
licence.limits: The PMMS page says its information "may be used with proper attribution" and may not be altered. The site's Terms of Use say data may not be redistributed or published without a written agreement, and forbid automated collection. The two conflict; the page's statement is the narrower one.

programs.name: House Price Index
programs.description: Repeat-sales indexes of single-family home prices for the nation, divisions, states and metro areas, monthly from 1991. Begun by OFHEO.

programs.name: H.15 Selected Interest Rates
programs.description: The federal funds rate, Treasury yields, the prime rate and other rates, daily from 1954: the whole release from the Data Download Program.

licence.attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
licence.note: The Board says information on its site is in the public domain and may be copied and distributed without permission, and asks that the Board be cited.

programs.name: Open Market Operations: Federal Funds Target Rate
programs.description: Every change in the FOMC's target federal funds rate or range since 1990, from the Board's Open Market Operations pages.

licence.attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

programs.name: Home Ownership Affordability Monitor
programs.description: The share of median income needed to own a median-priced home, and an affordability index, monthly from 2005.

licence.limits: Content may be reproduced without limit if not for private gain and with attribution to the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta; reproductions that abstract its material should be sent to its Public Affairs Department.

programs.name: Surveys of Consumers: Index of Consumer Sentiment
programs.description: The University of Michigan's monthly index of consumer sentiment, from 1952.

licence.attribution: University of Michigan, Survey Research Center, Surveys of Consumers
licence.limits: The usage agreement forbids reproducing, retransmitting, distributing, selling, publishing or broadcasting the data without the University's written consent, and limits display to the user's own organization.

programs.name: Provisional COVID-19 Death Counts by Week and State
programs.description: Deaths involving COVID-19, pneumonia and influenza by week and state, from 2020 (data.cdc.gov r8kw-7aab).
programs.outside_abstract: Covers 2020 on; the 2012 edition predates it.

programs.name: Population Estimates
programs.description: The Census Bureau's yearly estimates of the population of the nation and states, by age, sex, race and Hispanic origin where published, and the components of change, from 1900.

programs.name: Decennial Census
programs.description: The count every ten years: population of the states at every census from 1790, and apportionment of the House from 1910.

programs.name: Historical Census Statistics on Population Totals by Race, 1790 to 1990 (Working Paper 56)
programs.description: Census counts by race, and by Hispanic origin from 1970, for the nation, regions, divisions and states (Gibson and Jung, 2002).

programs.name: American Community Survey, 1-Year Estimates
programs.description: Yearly estimates for the nation, states and congressional districts from 2005 (none for 2020): the summary file tables GovGraph reads.

programs.name: Federal Register: Presidential Documents
programs.description: Executive orders and presidential memoranda: lists, metadata, structured HTML and PDF links, from the Federal Register API.

access.note: govinfo publishes the daily Federal Register as bulk XML (not yet used).

programs.name: Compilation of Presidential Documents
programs.description: The text of presidential documents (govinfo collection CPD); the plain text of Obama's executive orders comes from here.

programs.name: Bill Status (BILLSTATUS)
programs.description: One XML file per bill: titles, sponsors and cosponsors, actions, committees, related bills, text versions. Bulk data from the 108th Congress.

programs.name: Congressional Bills (BILLS)
programs.description: Every printed version of every bill, in bill XML.

programs.name: Public and Private Laws (PLAW)

programs.name: Congress.gov API
programs.description: Bills, laws and actions; used for the list of enacted laws, single bills and the newest updates.

access.note: Most of the same data is in govinfo's BILLSTATUS bulk files, already used for whole Congresses.

programs.name: House Roll Call Votes
programs.description: Every recorded vote in the House, one XML file per roll call.
programs.outside_abstract: Votes, not statistics. The Abstract's Elections section counts votes cast in elections, not in Congress.

programs.name: Senate Roll Call Votes
programs.description: Every recorded vote in the Senate, one XML file per roll call.
programs.outside_abstract: Votes, not statistics. The Abstract's Elections section counts votes cast in elections, not in Congress.

programs.name: congress-legislators
programs.description: Every member of Congress since 1789, presidents and vice presidents, with their terms and their ids in other systems.

licence.name: CC0 1.0
licence.note: Dedicated to the public domain.

programs.name: Biographical Directory of Article III Federal Judges
programs.description: Every federal judge since 1789 with their appointments; GovGraph reads the Justices from it.

programs.name: Supreme Court Slip Opinions
programs.description: Each term's list of decisions and the slip opinion PDFs.

programs.name: CourtListener
programs.description: Court opinions and dockets; used to find each Supreme Court slip opinion's PDF and to redirect old CourtListener ids.

licence.name: Public Domain Mark 1.0
licence.note: Free Law Project marks its bulk data files "free of known copyright restrictions" (Public Domain Mark). The website itself is CC BY-ND 4.0.

access.note: Bulk exports are published quarterly; the API may stay for finding new slip opinions between them.

programs.name: The Supreme Court Database
programs.description: Every Supreme Court decision coded by issue, parties, disposition and votes: the Modern Database (1946 on) and the Legacy Database (1791–1945).

licence.note: Described elsewhere as Creative Commons licensed; no licence found on the current site (2026-10-13).

programs.notes: Moved from scdb.wustl.edu (Washington University), which refused connections on 2026-10-13, to scdb.la.psu.edu (Penn State). seed/scdb.js still names the old address.

programs.name: United States Code (release points)
programs.description: The whole Code in USLM XML after each batch of laws.

access.note: Release 119-36 was taken from the Internet Archive while uscode.house.gov was down.

programs.name: The 9/11 Commission Report
programs.description: The final report (2004): the Commission's own HTML for the text, GPO's PDFs and record.

programs.name: CAP Master Topics Codebook
programs.description: The Comparative Agendas Project's topic system: 21 major topics and their subtopics, each with a code and a description. One of the structures on GovGraph's Structure page (server/seed/data/structures/comparative-agendas.json).

licence.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
licence.attribution: Jones, Bryan D., Frank R. Baumgartner, Sean M. Theriault, Derek A. Epp, Shruti Khandekar, Daniel Little. 2025. Policy Agendas Project: Codebook.
licence.note: Datasets and codebooks are © Comparative Agendas Project 2015; the topic codes and other project variables are under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0. Re-use must cite the How to Cite page (comparativeagendas.net/pages/How-to-cite), may not be commercial, and must be shared under the same licence: the structure file derived from it carries it. Where a dataset's codebook says so, the copyright of the primary source material applies too.

programs.outside_abstract: A classification of policy topics, not statistics; kept as an alternative to the Abstract's own arrangement.

programs.name: Producer Price Index
programs.description: Prices received by domestic producers, by commodity (BLS survey code `wp`, from 1913) and by industry (`pc`). Final demand–intermediate demand (FD-ID) has been the main aggregation since January 2014; the stage-of-processing indexes were discontinued with January 2016 data.

access.note: download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/wp/ and pc/, as for the CPI.

programs.name: Import/Export Price Indexes
programs.description: Prices of goods and services bought from and sold to other countries, by end use, by commodity classification and by locality of origin. BLS survey code `ei`.

access.note: download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/ei/.

programs.name: Monthly Energy Review
programs.description: EIA's summary of energy production, consumption, trade, prices and emissions, monthly and yearly; chapter 9 has the prices of fuels and electricity.

access.note: The total energy bulk file, www.eia.gov/opendata/bulk/TOTAL.zip (no key).

programs.name: USDA Food Plans: Cost of Food
programs.description: Monthly cost of a nutritious diet at four levels (Thrifty, Low-Cost, Moderate-Cost, Liberal), by age and sex and for example families. The Thrifty plan sets SNAP's maximum benefit.

access.note: One PDF a month for each plan; no bulk file found yet.

programs.name: Cost of Living Index (COLI)
programs.description: Relative cost of living for a professional household in about 270 participating urban areas, quarterly and as annual averages. Formerly the ACCRA Cost of Living Index.

licence.note: Sold by subscription: $180–$300 a year in 2025, by format (press releases at coli.org, read 2026-10-14). The Abstract printed it as copyright.

programs.name: FTSE/CoreCommodity CRB Index
programs.description: A futures price index of 19 commodities, begun by the Commodity Research Bureau in 1957; since then the Reuters/Jefferies, Thomson Reuters/CoreCommodity and Refinitiv/CoreCommodity CRB Index.

licence.note: A licensed benchmark (owned by LSEG and CoreCommodity Indexes, LLC; administered by FTSE International). The Abstract printed it as copyright.

programs.name: cmdty BLS Commodity Price Indexes
programs.description: Spot market price indexes of 22 raw commodities (all commodities, raw industrials, foodstuffs, and subgroups), begun by BLS and computed by the Commodity Research Bureau from 1981; the CRB/BLS spot indexes.

licence.note: Sold by Barchart (cmdty). The Abstract printed it as copyright.

programs.name: Analytical Perspectives, Budget of the U.S. Government
programs.description: The Budget's volume of analyses: trust funds' income, outlays and balances; tax expenditures; federal borrowing and debt; aid to states; and more, for the past year, the current year and the budget year.

access.note: Supplemental tables as spreadsheets beside each year's volume; one edition a year, each a snapshot of three years.

programs.name: U.S. Treasury Savings Bonds: Issues, Redemptions, and Maturities by Series
programs.description: Savings bonds issued, redeemed, matured and outstanding by series (E, EE, H, HH, I), monthly. Published by the Bureau of the Public Debt until it was merged into the Fiscal Service in 2012.

access.note: Fiscal Data's API (no key) or its CSV download, as for Debt to the Penny.

programs.name: Consolidated Federal Funds Report
programs.description: Federal spending by state and county: grants, salaries, procurement, direct payments, loans and insurance, fiscal years 1983–2010.

access.note: Historical reports and files remain on the Census site.

programs.notes: The Federal Financial Statistics program was ended with the FY 2012 budget, taking the CFFR and Federal Aid to States with it; the website closed on 2012-07-31. USAspending.gov's figures are not comparable with the CFFR's.

programs.name: USAspending
programs.description: Federal awards (contracts, grants, loans, direct payments) and account spending, with the recipient's place, from fiscal year 2008; required by the DATA Act of 2014.

access.note: Award data archive and bulk downloads (files.usaspending.gov), no key.

programs.outside_abstract: Successor to the Consolidated Federal Funds Report (Table 479), which the Abstract cites; USAspending itself began after the 2012 edition's data.

programs.name: IRS Data Book
programs.description: The IRS's yearly account of its work by fiscal year (Publication 55B): returns filed, collections by type of tax, refunds, examinations, collections enforcement, appeals.

access.note: One spreadsheet per table per year; table numbers changed over the years (gross collections by type of tax was Table 6, now Table 1-6).

programs.name: SOI Individual Income Tax Statistics
programs.description: Statistics of Income from individual returns by tax year: income, adjustments, deductions, credits and tax by size of adjusted gross income (Publication 1304 and the SOI Bulletin's tables), and by state.

access.note: Spreadsheets per table per tax year; state data as separate files.

programs.name: Federal Workforce Data
programs.description: The federal civilian workforce from OPM's personnel records (EHRI, formerly the Central Personnel Data File): employment, pay, accessions and separations by agency, location, occupation and characteristics, monthly. Succeeds FedScope (data to March 2025) and the printed series the Abstract cites (Employment and Trends, Pay Structure of the Federal Civil Service, Employment by Geographic Area, the Fact Book), all discontinued.

access.note: Downloadable datasets, updated monthly.

programs.name: Federal Real Property Profile (FRPP)
programs.description: Buildings, land and structures held by federal agencies, by agency and location, from the Federal Real Property Council's yearly inventory; the public dataset leaves out assets withheld for national security.

access.note: One spreadsheet per fiscal year (FY 2024 on data.gov, July 2025); GSA's own page lagged at FY 2022.

programs.name: Current Employment Statistics (CES)
programs.description: The payroll survey: employment, hours and earnings by industry, monthly, nationally from 1939 (BLS survey code `ce`) and for states and metro areas (`sm`).

access.note: download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/ce/ and sm/.

programs.name: Local Area Unemployment Statistics (LAUS)
programs.description: Labor force and unemployment for states, metro areas, counties and cities, monthly (BLS survey code `la`); also the Geographic Profile of Employment and Unemployment, state annual averages by characteristics from the CPS.

access.note: download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/la/; the Geographic Profile as yearly tables.

programs.name: Employment Projections
programs.description: Ten-year projections of the labor force, employment by industry and by occupation, revised each year.

access.note: Spreadsheet tables, replaced with each year's projections.

programs.name: Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS)
programs.description: Job openings, hires and separations (quits, layoffs and discharges, other), monthly from December 2000. BLS survey code `jt`.

access.note: download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/jt/.

programs.name: Business Employment Dynamics
programs.description: Gross job gains and losses from opening, expanding, contracting and closing establishments, quarterly from 1992, nationally and by state; built from the QCEW. BLS survey code `bd`.

access.note: download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/bd/.

programs.name: Mass Layoff Statistics
programs.description: Layoffs of 50 or more workers from one employer, by industry, reason and state, 1995–2013.

access.note: Historical tables remain on bls.gov.

programs.name: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)
programs.description: How people spend their time (work, household work, care, leisure), yearly from 2003, from a CPS follow-up interview. BLS survey code `tu`.

access.note: download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/tu/.

programs.name: Productivity and Costs
programs.description: Labor productivity, unit labor costs and related measures for the major sectors, quarterly from 1947 (`pr`), and for detailed industries, yearly (`ip`).

access.note: download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/pr/ and ip/.

programs.name: National Compensation Survey (NCS)
programs.description: Employer costs and benefits: the Employment Cost Index (`ci`), Employer Costs for Employee Compensation (`cm`), employee benefits (`nb`), and Modeled Wage Estimates (with OEWS).

access.note: download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/ci/, cm/, nb/.

programs.name: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW)
programs.description: Employment and wages from unemployment insurance records: every covered employer, by industry, county and state, quarterly and yearly.

access.note: Yearly CSV files by industry and by area (www.bls.gov/cew/downloadable-data-files.htm).

programs.name: National Longitudinal Surveys (NLS)
programs.description: Surveys following the same people for decades (NLSY79, NLSY97): jobs held, earnings, schooling.

access.note: Release tables; the microdata through NLS Investigator.

programs.name: Injuries, Illnesses, and Fatalities
programs.description: The Survey of Occupational Injuries and Illnesses (nonfatal cases and rates by industry; `ii`) and the Census of Fatal Occupational Injuries (`fw`, `fi`), yearly.

access.note: download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/ii/, fw/ and fi/.

programs.name: Major Work Stoppages
programs.description: Strikes and lockouts involving 1,000 or more workers, from 1947: number, workers involved, days idle. BLS survey code `ws`.

access.note: download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/ws/.

programs.name: Unemployment Insurance Data
programs.description: State unemployment insurance: initial and continued claims, insured unemployment, benefits paid, by state, weekly and yearly.

access.note: Weekly claims and the yearly UI Data Summary as files.

programs.name: Changes in Basic Minimum Wages Under State Law
programs.description: The federal minimum wage and each state's basic minimum wage, for selected years from 1968.

access.note: One page of tables.

programs.name: Current Population Reports
programs.description: The Census Bureau's reports from the Current Population Survey and population estimates, with their detailed tables: P20 (population characteristics, families and living arrangements), P23, P25, P60 (income, poverty, health insurance) and others. One program for every series (user, 2026-10-13).

access.note: Detailed tables as spreadsheets beside each report.

programs.name: Injury Facts
programs.description: The National Safety Council's statistics of deaths and injuries (work, home, road), annual as Accident Facts to 1998, then Injury Facts; online since 2018.

licence.note: The Abstract printed it as copyright. The site's terms page refused GovGraph's request (2026-10-14); read them before collecting.

programs.name: Union Membership and Coverage Database

licence.note: The book was copyright BNA. The website states no terms (2026-10-14).
